champion.tips: KLED TIPS AND TRICKS Abuse Kled’s duelling potential early by trading with the enemy as frequently as you can. Play overly aggressive if you know the enemy cannot match your damage. Don’t be afraid to roam with your Ultimate R to help other lanes out. If you’re ahead, you could recall and use your Ultimate R to help bot lane. Extended trades will always work in your favour, so go for extended trades over short ones whenever you can. Preferably, trade around your W .
champion.builds: THE BEST KLED BUILDS, RUNES AND ITEMS FOR MID IN EMERALD + Most Popular If you want to use the most popular Kled Mid build, you should take Flash and Ignite as your Summoner Spells. For runes, you should pick Conqueror as your keystone, followed by Triumph, Legend: Alacrity and Last Stand in the primary tree, as well as Bone Plating and Demolish in the secondary tree. For rune shards, you want Attack Speed in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health Scaling in defense, though it depends on the matchup. Finally, for your items, you should build Titanic Hydra as your first item, followed by Plated Steelcaps and Black Cleaver. For your last 3 items, you should build Overlord's Bloodmail, Sterak's Gage and finish with Death's Dance. For the skill order, you want to stick with Q - W - E. Right now, this build has 57.1% winrate over 168 matches played. Optional Your second option for Kled Mid build would be to take Flash and Ignite as your Summoner Spells. The runes that this build takes advantage of are Conqueror as your keystone, Triumph, Legend: Alacrity and Last Stand in the primary tree, and Demolish with Second Wind in the secondary tree. The shards used in this build are Adaptive Force in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health Scaling in defense. The items for the build are Profane Hydra, which you should build first, followed by Mercury's Treads as your second item and Voltaic Cyclosword as your third item. The rest of the items in order are Lord Dominik's Regards, Infinity Edge and Axiom Arc. The skill order for this build is Q - W - E. In the current patch, this build has a 51.4% win rate over 74 matches. Alternative If you're looking for alternatives, you can use Flash and Teleport as your Summoner Spells, with runes being Grasp of the Undying as your keystone, Demolish, Second Wind and Overgrowth in the primary tree, and Legend: Alacrity with Last Stand in the secondary tree, as well as Adaptive Force, Adaptive Force, and Health Scaling as your rune shards. The items that this build incorporates are Titanic Hydra as your first item, then Plated Steelcaps as a second item and Hullbreaker as a third item. You want to finish the build with Overlord's Bloodmail, Sterak's Gage and Lord Dominik's Regards. As far as ability max order goes, you want to keep it Q - W - E. This build is currently sitting at a 52.8% win rate across 53 matches played. Situational Kled Runes and Items Depending on the context of your game, your matchup, and enemy champions, you might want to consider building some situational items or take specific runes. Carefully examine your team, enemy team, game state , and your matchup to plan your Kled build accordingly! For example, when it comes to rune shards, you might want to take either Armor or Magic Resist, depending on which champion you are about to lane against. Furthermore, if you want a more detailed breakdown, you should also check out Kled runes page.
